messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Nectra (Enterprise onboarding) reported 3 UX blockers + 2 feature asks; customer called this out as a renewal concern. I'm dropping short notes here for triage.

Jordan Park: thanks. quick list?

Maya Chen: 1) SSO config page throws 500 when certain metadata is present/missing — crash during cert validation. 2) Billing UI: per-route rate multiplier not visible, customers assume default and overrun budget. 3) Prompt editor: saving a sample can overwrite team templates when names collide.

Li Wang: saw the SSO 500 in support ticket #5872 — attaching the stack snippet.

Li Wang: ```
error
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/sso/validate.py", line 142, in validate_metadata
    cert = parse_cert(metadata['cert'])
KeyError: 'cert'
```

Paul Rivers: for (2) billing UI — looks like leftover copy from the old mock. We can do a small UX patch: tooltip + banner warning.

Amir Patel: Nectra is up for renewal next month. Flagging this as renewal_risk :warning: — we should own comms today.

Jordan Park: OK — propose triage scoring: severity 1-5, frequency 1-5. Maya, Li can you give severity/frequency estimates?

Maya Chen: SSO crash - severity 4, freq 3 (seen in 2 out of 3 enterprise onboards this month). Billing UI - severity 3, freq 4. Prompt editor overwrite - severity 2, freq 2.

Li Wang: confirmed SSO occurs when metadata payload lacks the cert field. Likely higher frequency on customers using older IdP configs.

Jordan Park: Assign owners: @Paul Rivers — quick UX patch for billing UI, @devops-bot — investigate cert handling and potential hotfix, @Jordan Park (Product) — scope prompt-editor hardening. Maya to own customer comms and temporary workaround.

Maya Chen: I'll schedule a 30m with Nectra tomorrow and propose two immediate mitigations: 1) workaround to add a cert field manually in their IdP metadata, 2) temporary RBAC lock on prompt template overwrites. I'll follow up with step-by-step.

Paul Rivers: I'll push a tooltip + banner PR today, ETA EOD.

devops-bot: build pipeline triggered for branch sso-fix (#3424) — status: pending.

Amir Patel: capturing feature asks separately: (A) per-route sampling control (customer wants more deterministic sampling per route), (B) export prompt sets (CSV/JSON). Customer rated both as high-priority.

Jordan Park: I'll add both asks to the product board and weigh by renewal_impact + engineering_cost. Will attach links here once they're created.

Maya Chen: Thanks — I'll update ticket #5872 with the workaround steps and note the owners. Will post a short recap to the customer post-meeting and link back to this thread.

Paul Rivers: FYI I'll include a small mock in PR to show the tooltip copy.

Jordan Park: Great. If the SSO fix looks low-risk we should consider a short-lived patch release to reassure the customer.

Maya Chen: Agreed. I'll surface that in the call.

Amir Patel: Marking renewal_impact = high in the CRM record.

Maya Chen: Closing loop here for now — will update after the call. :white_check_mark:
